text:
sam: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add tiny compatibility shims for the streaming API deprecation. Need short examples for Python/TS/Go showing (1) new async iterator usage, (2) a one-line shim for teams using the old callback/`on_message` style, and (3) a migration note about retries+pagination interplay.

nina: Nice. Keep each snippet <= 8 lines. People copy/paste. For py show `async for chunk in client.stream(...)` then how to wrap into a callback with a helper.

frank: +1 on short. Also add a one-liner note about rate-limited retries — show `retry_after` handling in the shim.

aya: I can draft the Go snippet: show `for resp := range stream.Recv()` pattern and then a tiny func `WrapStream(handler func(string))` that spawns a goroutine and forwards messages.

sam: Draft plan: three short examples per language (native async, shim adapter, quick retry hint). I'll push to branch `docs/stream-shims` today.

nina: Ping me when it's in draft, I'll tidy the API names to match the latest SDK param names (we renamed `on_data` -> `on_message` last week).

frank: CI note — please add a tiny test snippet in the PR description that we can run manually (sanity only). Example: `python -c "from redwood import Client; print('ok')"`.

ci-bot: Build queued for refs/heads/docs/stream-shims — lint + snippet-check (this only runs docs linters).

sam: Pushed PR 34 with three snippet files: py.md, ts.md, go.md in `docs/snippets/streaming-shims`. Marked them WIP. Link: https://git.example/redwood/docs/pull/34

nina: skimmed. Py shim looks good but change `on_data` -> `on_message` and remove the `time.sleep` in the example. Also can we show an inline `asyncio.create_task` example instead of blocking?

aya: PR comment on Go: use `context.Context` in the wrapper so callers can cancel. Small patch incoming.

frank: Added a docs-only note about retries: "If you wrap the stream into a callback, make sure the retry/backoff lives outside the adapter or you'll double-retry partial results." Suggest one-liner code comment in each shim.

sam: Good catch — I'll add the comment to all three. Also adding a clarifying bullet: "Adapters don't change semantics for pagination — preserve continuation tokens in your handler."

nina: One more: include an explicit callout for the hosted API users to update to SDK >= 1.12.0 to get the new streaming API signatures.

sam: Done in PR description. Marking WIP -> Ready for review.

ci-bot: PR 34 lint passed. docs-snippet-check: warnings: none.

frank: Reviewing now, will post tiny nits. Let's aim to merge by EOD so we can announce in #announcements tomorrow.

aya: LGTM after my small ctx patch.

nina: Approved.

sam: Merged. Thanks all. I'll add a short migration note in the release notes: "streaming shim snippets for teams using callback-style integrations."

frank: Can we also add a short changelog line about the retry semantics and a link to the shim file?

sam: Added changelog entry and linked the snippet page. Closing thread.
